svg.title: Autocomplete latency by query class
svg.desc: p1: sift 0.21, sift (positions off) 0.20, pg_search 0.59, pg_textsearch 597, rum 23.21, pgx-bm25 5.00, Elasticsearch 0.40; p2: ; p3: sift 0.20, sift (positions off) 0.26, pg_search 0.75, pg_textsearch 9.06, rum 2.53, pgx-bm25 24.47, Elasticsearch 0.44; p4: ; w1: sift 0.19, sift (positions off) 0.19, pg_search 0.80, pg_textsearch 3.26, rum 0.32, pgx-bm25 1.67, Elasticsearch 0.26; a2: sift 0.24, sift (positions off) 0.20, pg_search 0.93, pg_textsearch 3.27, rum 4.95, pgx-bm25 3.65, Elasticsearch 0.27; a2s: ; a3: sift 0.29, sift (positions off) 0.25, pg_search 1.38, pg_textsearch 3.47, rum 4.65, pgx-bm25 7.68, Elasticsearch 0.28; x2: sift 0.24, sift (positions off) 0.25, pg_search 1.15, pg_textsearch 3.28, rum 3.03, pgx-bm25 3.84, Elasticsearch 0.33
svg.text: p50 milliseconds, logarithmic axis, lower is better
Error bars: one standard error over the interleaved rounds (rough for 2-3); red: relative error above 10%.
NA: no bar, the engine cannot run the workload or was not run on the dataset.
Elasticsearch: a JVM server over HTTP, edge n-grams of the typed words expanded by the client.
pg_textsearch: emulation (edge n-gram text, it has no native prefix scoring), see docs/BENCHMARKS.md.
p1-p4: 1-4 letter prefix; w1: whole word; a2, a2s: word + 2 or 1 letter prefix; a3, x2: 3 or 2 prefixes
GeoNames cities15000, 34,166 places, top-20, 1 client, median of 2-3 rounds; AMD Ryzen 7 9700X, 16 threads (load avg 7-12); Oct 2026.
